subject.title: Follow-up: optimize fallback order + add model-input config guardrail

question: What canonical fallback-order and configured-model-input contract should OpenClaw support for this follow-up: benchmarked cost-first ordering plus a focused guardrail, a different latency/quality/cost policy, or deferral?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but automation cannot safely choose benchmark criteria or tighten configured model input validation without deciding how custom multimodal provider metadata should remain valid.

options.title: Scope Cost-First Policy And Guardrail
options.body: Keep this issue as the broad fallback-policy tracker, use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/50287 for the input contract, and require benchmark evidence before implementation.

options.title: Reopen Or Create Narrow Cost Tracker
options.body: Move the fallback-order half to a dedicated open issue and leave this issue only as historical context.

options.title: Defer Policy Work
options.body: Keep current explicit fallback ordering and broad model-input metadata for now, documenting the risk until maintainers want a larger model-safety pass.

recommendation.title: Scope Cost-First Policy And Guardrail
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the broad fallback-policy tracker, use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/50287 for the input contract, and require benchmark evidence before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history across fallback policy, media provider routing, docs, and prior issue review context.
